title: CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION
  (Section 54956.9(d)(1) of the California Government Code)

  Dafne Lavi Moradi v. Los Angeles Department of Water and Power,
  Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 24SMCV03990.
summary: The water and power board will meet in closed session with its lawyers on the pending lawsuit Dafne Lavi Moradi v. LADWP.
